description: Service Long March Tyres (Private) Limited manufactures all-steel radial tyres for trucks, buses, light trucks and off-the-road use — the first all-steel radial truck and bus tyre made in Pakistan — and exports to customers in the USA, Brazil, the Middle East and Asia. The company was incorporated in January 2020 and is part of the Servis Group.
sourceNote: Company website (slmtires.com: home, about-us, contact) and the PSX company profile record, read 2026-10-17. The telephone number is published on the site as 0323-SLMTYRE.
